title: Urology-Sentinel (UroSentinel): explainable, ethics-by-design AI for bladder health screening and differential diagnosis (research prototype)
description:
Urology-Sentinel (UroSentinel) is version 3 of the Urology prediction model. It combines population screening for an overactive bladder (OAB-wet) proxy on pooled NHANES survey data, classical rough set rules on the UCI Acute Inflammations dataset, and a six-condition clinical differential (OAB, IC/BPS, acute and recurrent cystitis, neurogenic bladder, bladder outlet obstruction). It provides SHAP and LIME explanations, patient and clinician screens, a Gradio web app, a UK data loader for approved sources, and a V-EGRCSbyD governance checklist with model cards. It builds on two ABH 2026 studies: a comparative deep learning study for symptom-based OAB prediction with SHAP explainability (Subbiah and Ramachandran) and rough set-augmented ensemble machine learning for OAB/BPS differential diagnosis (Ramachandran and Kavitha).

Research prototype only: not a medical device and does not diagnose any condition.
